description: By moonlight, El Torcal looks like another planet — the great limestone sculptures stacked like stone pancakes along the Green Route, with El Tornillo's famous screw profile rising above the trail. No artificial light reaches up here; the pale rock drinks the moonlight while the plain of Antequera glitters far below. Clear and mild at about 24°C, with a light night breeze moving through the stone city.
